# Mint Clinic By Dr. Saurabh Ahuja
> Dental clinic on Old Bus Stand Road, Rohtak, Haryana led by Dr. Saurabh Ahuja (Doctor of Dental Medicine · Dental Surgeon).
Address: Near Old Bus Stand, Bus Stand Road, Rohtak Station Diary Mohalla, Rohtak, Haryana 124001. Phone: +91 81810 60000.
Hours: Monday to Saturday 09:00-18:00 IST; Sunday closed.

## Primary services
Dental implants, root canal treatment, crowns and bridges, braces, clear aligners, veneers and smile-focused dentistry, preventive check-ups and cleaning, gum care, emergency dental consultations, wisdom-tooth assessment, and missing-tooth replacement planning.

## Search intent coverage
The site includes dedicated pages for Rohtak dental services, common dental problems, urgent dental concerns, and selected Rohtak-area location pages. Content is intended to help patients understand treatment options and contact the clinic; clinical suitability is determined during consultation.
